# [STORY] As an operator, I want distributed tracing and contract tests across services, so that request flows are observable and service contracts don't silently break

## User Story
**As an** operator
**I want** distributed tracing and contract tests across services
**So that** request flows are observable and service contracts don't silently break

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a request crosses multiple services, when Micrometer Tracing/Zipkin is active, then the full trace is visible in Zipkin
- [x] Given the gateway or movie-service changes its contract, when contract tests run, then a breaking change fails CI instead of reaching production
